why: «публицист» is a false friend: in Russian it means a writer of opinion journalism, not someone who gets public attention for a client (gloss and all three examples are the PR-agent sense)
«воспаление» is inflammation, a different concept (and the gloss for the separate entry *inflammation* in the same file); the gloss defines an illness caused by germs entering the body
plural «газы» reads as intestinal gas; the fizz in a drink is «газ» in the singular (напиток с газом, газ выдохся)
